comparisons.peer_topic: 2024 Process Node Manufacturing Status and Roadmap Changes
comparisons.peer_summary: As of the end of 2024, most products were manufactured using the Intel 7 node, while high-volume production of the Intel 4 and Intel 3 nodes was shifted to Ireland. The company canceled the productization of Intel 20A to focus on the improved Intel 18A node, which is expected to enter high-volume production in 2025.
comparisons.comparison: Both Micron and Intel disclose specific milestones regarding the transition to or status of advanced process nodes using EUV lithography. Micron reports being on track for volume production of its 1-gamma DRAM node using EUV in 2025 and has begun volume production of its G9 NAND node. Similarly, Intel reports that it successfully ramped its Intel 4 and Intel 3 nodes, identifying them as its 'first EUV lithography nodes,' and shifted their high-volume production to Ireland, while also adjusting its roadmap to focus on the Intel 18A node for 2025 high-volume production.

sentences.text: Our 1-gamma DRAM pilot production using EUV lithography is progressing well, and we are on track for volume production in calendar 2025.

As of the end of 2024, a significant majority of our products were manufactured using our Intel 7 process node in Arizona and Israel, we successfully ramped our Intel 4 and Intel 3 process nodes as our first EUV lithography nodes and shifted high-volume production of those nodes to Ireland, and we canceled the productization of our Intel 20A process node to focus efforts on the improved version of the node, Intel 18A, that we expect to put into high-volume production in 2025 with our new client family of products code-named Panther Lake.

comparisons.peer_topic: Fabless manufacturing strategy and cost benefits
comparisons.peer_summary: NVIDIA utilizes a fabless and contracting manufacturing strategy, employing partners for wafer fabrication, assembly, testing, and packaging to avoid significant costs and risks associated with owning manufacturing operations. This approach allows the company to focus resources on product design, quality assurance, marketing, and customer support.
comparisons.comparison: While Micron discloses active volume production of its G9 NAND node and upcoming 1-gamma DRAM volume, indicating an integrated device manufacturer (IDM) model with internal fabrication, NVIDIA explicitly states it utilizes a fabless strategy. NVIDIA avoids the costs and risks of owning manufacturing operations by employing partners for all phases, including wafer fabrication, allowing it to focus on design. This highlights a fundamental difference in how these semiconductor peers execute on production milestones: Micron manages its own manufacturing nodes, whereas NVIDIA relies entirely on external foundries.

sentences.text: We have begun volume production on our Micron G9 NAND node, and expect to introduce several industry-leading products over the coming quarters.

We utilize a fabless and contracting manufacturing strategy, whereby we employ and partner with key suppliers for all phases of the manufacturing process, including wafer fabrication, assembly, testing, and packaging.
Additionally, we can avoid many of the significant costs and risks associated with owning and operating manufacturing operations.
